scenario.title: An undefined identifier is ignored, and the receive path still works afterwards
scenario.description: Put an identifier the contract does not define on the bus while the pack is idle. No fault may be raised, the pack's telemetry must continue, and its contactor must not move. Then command drive on an identifier the contract does define, and require the pack to act on it — proving the silence above was a decision and not a dead receive path.

params.label: the pack starts idle: contactor open

steps.params: pack held idle: charge port idle, vehicle parked
0x123 appears on the bus: an identifier this vehicle does not define

params.label: an undefined identifier raises no fault
the pack keeps publishing its telemetry

steps.params: an identifier that IS defined, on the same receive path

params.label: a defined identifier still moves the pack: the receive path is alive
